title: Grateful Dead Live at Poplar Creek Music Theatre on 1983-06-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Average audience recording with Jerry up front and a smoking Sugaree performance
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a good Dead concert, highlighted by an especially fiery rendition of "Sugaree" and a prominent Jerry Garcia mix. However the recording lacks a proper soundboard source, leaving Phil Lesh's bass thump weak and the overall balance fair, requiring software tricks to pull out low end.

ai_rating.rationale: One review gives a 3‑star rating, noting solid musical performance but significant recording shortcomings; the weighted average leans toward an overall modest score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Jerry's guitar is front‑center while Phil's bass thump is missing; overall mix feels thin on low end and would benefit from a true soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing; reviewer only mentions overall enjoyment of the show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: More upfront and centered in the mix, highlighted positively.
band_member_comments.Phil: Missing the characteristic bass thump; weak low‑end presence.
